newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly weaker.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open slightly weaker Friday as LME metals saw muted dealings overnight.
COMEX July copper was called off 0.20 to 0.40 cent from Thursday's close of 117.00 cents a lb.
LME warehouse copper stocks rose fell 175 tonnes to 132,625 tonnes in Friday's data, while COMEX copper stocks fell 44 short tons Thursday to 42,085 short tons.
On ACCESS, July copper last traded at 116.70 cents, off 0.30 cent from Thursday's close.
The LME cash to three months backwardation was stable at $60/$65.
